verses.text: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

xrefs.text: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
“I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.

verses.text: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.

xrefs.text: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
Alas, the tumult of many peoples; they rage like the roaring seas and clamoring nations; they rumble like the crashing of mighty waters.

When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood, he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon,

verses.text: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,

xrefs.text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
‘Let us invade Judah, terrorize it, and divide it among ourselves. Then we can install the son of Tabeal over it as king.’
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.text: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

xrefs.text: There is no longer praise for Moab; in Heshbon they devise evil against her: ‘Come, let us cut her off from nationhood.’ You too, O people of Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.

For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”

And when he learned the identity of Mordecai’s people, he scorned the notion of laying hands on Mordecai alone. Instead, he sought to destroy all of Mordecai’s people, the Jews, throughout the kingdom of Xerxes.
They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase even more; and if a war breaks out, they may join our enemies, fight against us, and leave the country.

verses.text: For with one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You—

xrefs.text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
Huddle together, O peoples, and be shattered; pay attention, all you distant lands; prepare for battle, and be shattered; prepare for battle, and be shattered!
These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.
For Aram, along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has plotted your ruin, saying:

verses.text: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

xrefs.text: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead.
Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
And now, here are the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, whom You did not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt. So Israel turned away from them and did not destroy them.
After this, the Moabites and Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war against Jehoshaphat.
They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

verses.text: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.

xrefs.text: the land of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.
The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights, repairing your leaks. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to barter for your merchandise.
Tell Tyre, who dwells at the gateway to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coasts, that this is what the Lord GOD says: You have said, O Tyre, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
Thus the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to meet the Philistines in battle and camped at Ebenezer, while the Philistines camped at Aphek.

verses.text: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah

xrefs.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.
The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.
Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom.

verses.text: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,

xrefs.text: For as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden, the bar across their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.
Then they waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
The River Kishon swept them away, the ancient river, the River Kishon. March on, O my soul, in strength!
And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera, all his charioteers, and all his army. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.
Early in the morning Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) and all the men with him camped beside the spring of Harod. And the camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.

verses.text: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

xrefs.text: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
Then Saul said to his servants, “Find me a woman who is a medium, so I can go and consult her.” “There is a medium at Endor,” his servants replied.
Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh was assigned Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor (that is, Naphath), Endor, Taanach, and Megiddo, each with their surrounding settlements.

“They will die from deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried, but will lie like dung on the ground. They will be finished off by sword and famine, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and beasts of the earth.”
And Jezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field on the plot of ground at Jezreel, so that no one can say: This is Jezebel.’

verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

xrefs.text: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, Gideon pursued and captured these two kings of Midian, routing their entire army.

verses.text: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”

xrefs.text: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession that You gave us as an inheritance.
They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

verses.text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

xrefs.text: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?
May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner have their stems taken root in the ground, than He blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble.
Alas, the tumult of many peoples; they rage like the roaring seas and clamoring nations; they rumble like the crashing of mighty waters.
“I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.

verses.text: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

xrefs.text: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.

“For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
For wickedness burns like a fire that consumes the thorns and briers and kindles the forest thickets, which roll upward in billows of smoke.

Say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to ignite in you a fire, and it will devour all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and by it every face from south to north will be scorched.
If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,

verses.text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.

xrefs.text: For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause.
Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry— He will sweep them away.
I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;

verses.text: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

xrefs.text: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.

verses.text: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

xrefs.text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.

verses.text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.

xrefs.text: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
I will magnify and sanctify Myself, and I will reveal Myself in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
“Therefore behold, I will inform them, and this time I will make them know My power and My might; then they will know that My name is the LORD.
Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
And now, O LORD our God, please save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”
